header.title: EU Accessibility Act
header.subtitle: EU-wide rules to ensure products and services are accessible to persons with disabilities.

facts.title: Who this affects
facts.description: Plus service providers in ICT, e-commerce, banking, ticketing, media, and transport sectors — both public and private.

facts.title: Enforcement & penalties
facts.value: Fines set by each Member State
facts.description: Typically aligned with consumer protection regimes

items.title: Meet core accessibility requirements
items.text: Ensure products and services are perceivable, operable and understandable for persons with disabilities, following harmonised EN standards where available.

items.title: Design & development integration
items.text: Embed accessibility in design, testing, and procurement processes, ensuring accessibility features are considered from concept to release.

items.title: Information & instructions
items.text: Provide product and service information, usage instructions, and support channels in accessible formats (digital and physical).

items.title: Digital service compliance
items.text: Websites, apps, e-commerce platforms, and self-service terminals must comply with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 AA.

items.title: Procurement & supply chain oversight
items.text: Contractually require accessibility compliance from suppliers and ensure third-party products integrate without barriers.

items.title: Documentation & conformity assessment
items.text: Maintain technical documentation, declarations of conformity, and evidence to prove compliance to authorities and clients.

offer.title: What we offer
